core.title: Storefront Door Lever Handle, Global TH1100-LH1

text.description_html:
Global TH1100-LH1 Door Lever Handle

Storefront aluminum door lever handle.

For use with Global TH1103 Deadlatch, or any brand of narrow stile mortise deadlatch.

Also see: Store Door Hardware for Push / Pull Handles and related hardware.

Lever is reversible. Handing can easily be reversed on cam plug by removing C-clip and flipping the cam over and reinstaling C-clip. The cam-plug is secured to the lever by 2 hardened steel pins. The cam-plug locks into the deadlatch by use of a set screw in the deadbolt.

Specifications:

  • Lever: Aluminum alloy cast
  • Escutcheon: Aluminum 1-3/8" x 4", heavy duty spring mechanism prevents sagging of lever handle
  • Spindle: Wrought steel, 1/4" square hardened heat treated
  • Non handed, easily reversible
  • Operation: Turning lever downward will activate deadlatch
  • Available in two finishes

Standard package includes: Cam plug, mouting screws, template, and installation instructions.
